page_title: BHA 1-2 CHE | Brighton v Chelsea 15/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van Hecke J. P. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+12' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+11' A lofted cross from Valentin Barco (Brighton) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90+10' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+10' Brighton take a short corner kick.
90+10' Valentin Barco (Brighton) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The linesman makes the right call and Brighton will have a corner.
90+9' Substitution. Cesare Casadei replaces Cole Palmer (Chelsea).
90+9' Substitution. Conor Gallagher makes his way off the pitch and Lesley Ugochukwu (Chelsea) comes on as his replacement.
90+7' 1 - 2 It's 1:2! Joao Pedro feeds Danny Welbeck (Brighton) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
90+6' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+5' Simon Adingra (Brighton) attempts to test the goalkeeper after collecting a cross inside the penalty area. Luck doesn't appear to be on his side today as his attempt rattles the left post.
90+3' Great teamplay by Brighton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
90' The substitution has been made. Thiago Silva (Chelsea) has replaced Nicolas Jackson.
88' Referee Michael Salisbury seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s RED for Reece James (Chelsea).

87' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Reece James (Chelsea), but referee Michael Salisbury must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
87' Reece James (Chelsea) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
85' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Ansu Fati (Brighton) replaces Julio Enciso.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Odeluga Offiah (Brighton) will replace Tariq Lamptey.
85' Valentin Barco (Brighton) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
84' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Bart Verbruggen.
82' Chelsea win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
81' The game has begun to heat up. Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
79' Michael Salisbury shows a yellow card to Moises Caicedo (Chelsea), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
78' Valentin Barco (Brighton) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
77' Michael Salisbury shows a yellow card to Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) for a tough tackle.
76' Simon Adingra (Brighton) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort high over the bar.
72' The resulting set piece from Chelsea is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
71' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Corner kick. Chelsea will have an opportunity.
70' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Billy Gilmour will be replaced by Carlos Baleba (Brighton).
70' It will be a substitution. Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is ready to enter the pitch as Facundo Buonanotte walks off.
69' Substitution. Malo Gusto did his best and is replaced by Reece James (Chelsea).
69' Mauricio Pochettino prepares a substitution. Noni Madueke is replaced by Raheem Sterling (Chelsea).
68' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
64' 0 - 2 Malo Gusto feeds the ball through to Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:2!
62' The resulting corner from Valentin Barco (Brighton) is cleared by the defence.
61' Simon Adingra (Brighton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
60' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) whips the ball into the box and Christopher Nkunku takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.

57' Pascal Gross (Brighton) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post.
55' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
54' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
54' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
53' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
52' A short pass from Cole Palmer puts Malo Gusto (Chelsea) in the clear inside the box with just the keeper to beat, but his shot sails well wide of the left post.
50' The Chelsea players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
50' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul after Valentin Barco (Brighton) hacks down one of his opponents. Chelsea have a free kick.
49' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
48' The Brighton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
47' Simon Adingra (Brighton) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
46' The referee signals a substitution. Valentin Barco (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for Lewis Dunk.
46' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+10' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+9' What a chance that is! Joao Pedro (Brighton) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
45+8' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
45+7' The corner is swung in but Chelsea can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+6' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Chelsea get a corner.
45+5' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
45+4' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
45+2' The linesman signals that Simon Adingra (Brighton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
45' 9 additional min. will be played.
45' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) trips an opposition player and Michael Salisbury signals a foul.
44' The resulting corner from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) comes to nothing.
44' A pass lands at the feet of Cole Palmer (Chelsea) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Chelsea will take a corner kick.
43' The foul by Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) was seen by Michael Salisbury who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
42' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christopher Nkunku is coming onto the pitch as Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
40' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes.
37' Looks like Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
34' 0 - 1 Cole Palmer (Chelsea) jumps for a cross and plants a brilliant header into the top right corner.
32' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
31' Simon Adingra (Brighton) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
30' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Cole Palmer (Chelsea).
29' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Michael Salisbury didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
27' A cross from a corner kick by Chelsea is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

26' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Bart Verbruggen sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. It will be a corner kick for Chelsea.
25' Julio Enciso (Brighton) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! He sent the ball into the stands. What a miserable header!
22' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Chelsea.
18' The Chelsea players are stunned as referee Michael Salisbury changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
17' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.

17' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle after Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Chelsea.
16' Chelsea have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
13' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
12' The free kick is delivered by Pascal Gross (Brighton) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
12' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) picks up an injury.
11' Simon Adingra (Brighton) has time and space to shoot after latching onto a pass, but his screamer of a shot flies just wide of the left post.
9' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Salisbury blows for a foul.
8' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
7' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
6' Pascal Gross (Brighton) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. Brighton force their opponents to concede a corner.
4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Chelsea.
4' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop. The ball is out of play. Chelsea win a corner kick.
1' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The match has just started.
Chelsea will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Michael Salisbury.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
